heading: FESOP; limitations on operation of engines
affected_activity: Running RPL's three emergency standby generators for maintenance checks and readiness testing.
reason: RPL operates 3 emergency standby generators, so the annual testing-hours cap in this FESOP section can affect its operating practice and permits.
quote: (b) The owner or operator shall limit operation for maintenance checks and readiness testing to one hundred (100) hours per calendar year.

heading: Stationary engines; emission limits
affected_activity: Emission limits for stationary reciprocating engines used as emergency generators.
reason: RPL has emergency standby generators, which are stationary reciprocating engines covered by this subpart.
quote: (b) An owner or operator of an emergency engine shall limit carbon monoxide to 20 ppmvd at 15 percent oxygen.

heading: Utility fees; calculation
affected_activity: Paying the annual IURC utility fee on gross intrastate operating revenues.
reason: RPL is an IURC-jurisdictional Indiana utility, so the higher fee rate applies to its annual fee.
quote: (b) The fee rate is twelve-hundredths of one percent (0.12%) of gross intrastate operating revenues.

heading: Energy efficiency programs; applicability
affected_activity: Annual energy efficiency program reporting to the IURC.
reason: RPL is an electric utility under IURC jurisdiction; if it files program reports, the new breakout applies.
quote: (b) A utility shall file an annual program report with the commission and shall include verified savings by customer class.

heading: Large load interconnection; definitions
affected_activity: Handling requests from customer loads of 100 MW or more to interconnect.
reason: A new large load interconnection process applies to IURC-jurisdictional electric utilities such as RPL.
quote: (b) A utility shall provide a written interconnection study estimate within sixty (60) days of a complete application.

heading: Emission limits for nitrogen oxides; turbines
affected_activity: Limiting NOx from new natural gas turbines.
reason: RPL owns no generating units, so a turbine NOx standard does not apply.
quote: (b) The owner or operator of a turbine firing natural gas shall not discharge into the atmosphere any gases that contain nitrogen oxides in excess of 15 ppm at 15 percent oxygen.

heading: Carbon dioxide emission standards
affected_activity: CO2 output standards for fossil fuel-fired generating units.
quote: (b) An affected unit shall not discharge more than 1,200 lb CO2 per MWh gross output.

heading: Electric utility steam generating units; compliance
affected_activity: Compliance averaging for electric utility steam generating units.
reason: RPL owns no steam generating units.
quote: (b) An owner or operator shall demonstrate compliance on a 30-day rolling average basis.

heading: Particulate emission limitations
reason: RPL operates no manufacturing process or generating unit that emits particulate.
quote: (b) Particulate emissions shall not exceed 0.02 grain per dry standard cubic foot of exhaust.

heading: Non-discriminatory open access transmission tariff
affected_activity: Open access transmission tariff and market monitor reporting.
reason: RPL operates no transmission above 100 kV and is not a transmission provider under the tariff.
quote: (b) A market monitoring unit shall report to the Commission any identified market design flaw within twenty (20) days.

heading: Generator interconnection
reason: RPL owns no generation and runs no transmission, so it processes no generator interconnection studies under this section.
quote: (b) The provider shall complete each system impact study within sixty (60) days of a complete request.

heading: Gas pipeline safety; applicability
quote: (b) A leak survey of each distribution main shall be completed every two (2) years.

heading: Water and sewage utilities; applicability
affected_activity: Rate case notices for water and sewage utilities.
reason: RPL has no water or sewage operations.
quote: (b) A utility shall file a rate case notice thirty (30) days before filing.

heading: Stormwater; construction
affected_activity: Notices of intent for construction sites that disturb land.
reason: RPL has underground facilities and does construction work, but whether any site reaches the new half-acre threshold depends on project size.
quote: (b) A site disturbing one-half (0.5) acre or more shall submit a notice of intent before land disturbance begins.

heading: NOx rules; applicability
affected_activity: NOx rule applicability by annual tons emitted.
reason: RPL's standby generators emit NOx, but their annual tons relative to the new 15-ton threshold are not in the profile.
quote: (b) A source that emits fifteen (15) tons or more of NOx per year is subject to this rule.

heading: Information to be posted on an OASIS
reason: RPL has no transmission above 100 kV, but may post outages through its MISO transmission owner.
quote: (b) The provider shall post planned outages when they are scheduled and shall update the posting within one (1) business day of any change.
